name: mbedfx
description: Discord embed fixer for 17 social sites: swap a link's domain and the post unfurls with its video.

scripts.// deploy: DEPLOYS THE GENERIC CONFIG (wrangler.jsonc) as its own Worker, mbedfx-selfhost, and that name is what makes it safe to have. Until 2026-11-25 this script refused, because the root file WAS production's: a hand `wrangler deploy` raced Cloudflare Workers Builds on the container image and on which version ended up live, and it once left the live worker on a hand-uploaded version while three Workers Builds runs failed and prod looked healthy. Production now deploys only from Workers Builds, with `npx wrangler deploy -c wrangler.production.jsonc` on main, and nothing here names that file (test/wrangler-configs.test.mjs). Run by the owner, this script creates or updates a SEPARATE Worker in the owner's account, with its own bucket, dataset and container application, and its own container bill. That is what a self-hoster and the Deploy to Cloudflare button want, and what the owner should not do by accident. The deploy that must never run by hand is `npx wrangler deploy -c wrangler.production.jsonc`.
scripts.// build: THE CI GATE, and it is not a no-op despite a Worker needing no build step. Cloudflare Workers Builds runs `npm run build` before its deploy command; with no such script the build FAILED and nothing shipped (measured 2026-07-26: three consecutive failed builds on main, phase-2 and staging, all 'Missing script: build', while the live worker sat on a hand-uploaded version). Pointing it at the suite turns that required-and-previously-broken step into the gate that was lost when deploys moved off GitHub Actions: a red suite or a type error now fails the build, so it never reaches deploy. This matters more here than on a typical worker because Discord CACHES the og:video url we serve, keyed by a url that never changes — a bad deploy outlives its own fix.
scripts.// test:container: EXECUTES container/server.py rather than reading it as text. NOT in `build`: that script is the Cloudflare Workers Builds gate and python3 is not guaranteed in that image, so a failure there would block the deploy instead of catching a bug. GitHub Actions runs it on ubuntu-latest.

MEDIA_CACHE.description: The R2 bucket that keeps muxed videos, post metadata and translations, so a repeat card doesn't fetch them again.

AE.description: The Analytics Engine dataset that counts each card's platform and outcome, never its URL or the reader's IP.

AI.description: Workers AI, which translates captions that aren't in English.

MUX_RUNNER.description: A Durable Object that retries a video's mux on an alarm when the first attempt runs out of time.

SMOKE_RUNNER.description: A Durable Object that runs the half-hourly check of one known post per site from eastern North America.

MEDIA_RESOLVER.description: The Durable Object behind the yt-dlp and ffmpeg container that turns a site's video into one MP4, which needs Workers Paid.
